newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns AA+ to TEPCO's 100 bln yen bonds.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA+ to TEPCO's 100 bln yen bonds.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday that it had assigned its AA+ rating to Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc's (TEPCO) 100 billion yen 2.5 percent straight bond maturing on May 15, 2007.
S&P also said the rating outlook is stable.
The ratings reflect TEPCO's very strong position as the dominant provider of electricity to Japan's Kanto region, an area around Tokyo, S&P said.
The rating agency also said TEPCO's financial risk is acceptable for the rating category.
